mapper.sql: WITH facts AS ( SELECT i.question_id,i.outcome judgment,s.submitted_at,s.id session_id, bool_or(s.auto_add_wrong_book AND i.outcome='WRONG') OVER ( PARTITION BY i.question_id ORDER BY s.submitted_at,s.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) wrong_book_member, row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY i.question_id ORDER BY s.submitted_at DESC,s.id DESC) rn FROM practice_item i JOIN practice_session s ON s.id=i.session_id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.status='SUBMITTED' AND i.outcome IN ('CORRECT','WRONG','SELF_RATED') ), totals AS ( SELECT question_id,count(*) FILTER(WHERE judgment='CORRECT') right_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE judgment='WRONG' AND wrong_book_member) wrong_count FROM facts GROUP BY question_id ), self_facts AS ( SELECT i.question_id,'SELF_RATED' judgment,i.self_assessment,s.submitted_at, row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY i.question_id ORDER BY s.submitted_at DESC,s.id DESC) rn FROM practice_item i JOIN practice_session s ON s.id=i.session_id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.status='SUBMITTED' AND i.outcome='SELF_RATED' AND i.self_assessment IS NOT NULL )
